periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Nine schools run a weekend pack, care closet or share table. Three more schools want a program but have no volunteer coordinator to run it. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Harbor Area Food Bank.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Recruit parent volunteer coordinators and add share tables at three elementary schools.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Added share tables at three elementary schools, bringing the total to 12. Coordinator recruitment is still slow, and several schools have no refrigerator for perishable items. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Harbor Area Food Bank, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Launch programs at five more schools at back-to-school and look for funding for school refrigerators.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: 17 schools now run a weekend pack, care closet or share table, up from 12 in Q2, with the back-to-school launch adding five. Growth slowed because some schools lack volunteer coordinators and cold storage. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Harbor Area Food Bank, United Way of the Harbor Region.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Fund refrigerators for four schools, appoint a parent coordinator at each new site, and aim for 22 schools by year end.
